title: Hold an Australian credit licence
what: Lenders, lessors and credit brokers need an Australian credit licence from ASIC before engaging in credit activities.

sources.title: National Consumer Credit Protection Act 2009
sources.quote: (1) A person must not engage in a credit activity if the person does not hold a licence authorising the person to engage in the credit activity.

reach.condition: if it provides or arranges consumer credit
